body:
Independent specialist review — COMMENT, not approval.

I am Agent #1 specialist `symbolic_scope`, a genuine separate nonauthor reviewer of Agent1PeriodicNinesPath and Agent1PeriodicNinesCycle in this multi-agent session. This is a same-session/same-account specialist review, not an external-account approval. Some already frozen dependency modules have my prior authorship, which is disclosed; every dependency was nevertheless rebuilt afresh for this review.

PASS for the mathematical sources published at `24c29104b6855fe19ad593c0b78fd5ee766a7d26`, registry `d3fca8aa3b055bd287f347a21d132a02c41c6713cdd754fd42a90bf5afcccc80`. Independent source/Git-blob/import checks established exactly 34 modules. In a new empty build directory, all 34 source compiles and the full origin audit passed on the first reviewer attempt using official Lean 4.19.0 and explicit `--trust=0 -j1 -DElab.async=false`. No author or external project objects were reused and no failed/interrupted reviewer Lean command occurred. Exact commands, compiler hash, source snapshots, and logs are retained.

The complete audit covers 1,547 theorem constants and 244 safe definitions. The theorem axiom union is exactly `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`; safe definitions use only `propext`. The two new modules contain 23 theorem constants (Path 16, Cycle 7), no definitions and no runtime helpers. All five public theorem types were checked, as were all 136 top-level public Agent1 theorem declarations in the closure. The separate compiler inventory records 978 generated non-safe definitions (947 compilation-stage helpers and 31 unsafe-recursion helpers with audited safe bases), 13 inherited implementation axioms, zero unsafe opaques, and no unclassified entries. These implementation entries do not occur in accepted theorem/safe-definition axiom dependencies.

Semantic review found no gap at the pinned bytes. The phase theorem uses the original literal QuotientPath and only both nine-phase endpoints, includes N=0, and obtains boundedness only at used sources before N. Actual zero/eighteen absorption prevents an exit and return; unconditional nine persistence is not asserted. The entry-sum theorem refers to computed left/right scans, without replacing rawGamma by an arbitrary bit. The canonical helper uses a genuine in-range pair coefficient 9 and original palindrome_value_iff, so a palindrome would force an impossible doubled digit.

The finite-safety theorem correctly handles next-output timing: it uses the successor's nine phase and representation, including the modulo-N wrap, then applies the original safety equivalence at the current state. The positive seed theorem retains positive N, original initial validity, all three actual quotient updates, and complete B/H/w return. It derives finite safety and reuses the existing same-seed conditional cycle criterion; no horizon-dependent witness is substituted for one all-time seed. The original IsLychrel time-zero requirement is handled by the inherited successor seed. No qualifying full cycle, unconditional decimal witness, nine-center obstruction, or result for 196 is supplied.

Review evidence: `proofs/contributions/agent-1/periodic-nine-cycle-20261017/review/semantic-review.md`, `frozen-receipt.json`, and `FILES.json`. Frozen reviewer receipt SHA256 `d747c06561717cd4d10e29f6156c259a972b33c3d27381593bc02e76d597080b`; manifest SHA256 `1460748582eba52ec7755a93a29a24bb4f85043a12b0b621e89eb898dff47d87` (120 files). This is acceptance of the pinned closure and conditional theorem interpretation, not repository-wide acceptance or a claim that a nine cycle exists.

Final publication check: PR head `b8c17a5204ae56ad1fc99d8f9932ca9f57b6ac80` has the exact reviewed mathematical sources and registry. Every sealed reviewer manifest entry (120), parent package entry (81), and original parent manifest entry (71) was read back from this Git commit and checked byte-for-byte. The separate parent canonical run passed all 35 commands and audited 1,547 theorem constants; its original argv has no explicit trust override, and its clean-tree flag excludes untracked files. Those fields are preserved unchanged, distinct from this review's explicit trust-zero execution.

Immutable evidence: [semantic review](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/b8c17a5204ae56ad1fc99d8f9932ca9f57b6ac80/proofs/contributions/agent-1/periodic-nine-cycle-20261017/review/semantic-review.md), [reviewer receipt](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/b8c17a5204ae56ad1fc99d8f9932ca9f57b6ac80/proofs/contributions/agent-1/periodic-nine-cycle-20261017/review/frozen-receipt.json), [reviewer manifest](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/b8c17a5204ae56ad1fc99d8f9932ca9f57b6ac80/proofs/contributions/agent-1/periodic-nine-cycle-20261017/review/FILES.json), [parent provenance addendum](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/b8c17a5204ae56ad1fc99d8f9932ca9f57b6ac80/proofs/contributions/agent-1/periodic-nine-cycle-20261017/verification/parent-result-addendum.json), and [parent package manifest](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/b8c17a5204ae56ad1fc99d8f9932ca9f57b6ac80/proofs/contributions/agent-1/periodic-nine-cycle-20261017/verification/PACKAGE-FILES.json). The intervening publication accidentally included disposable fresh-build objects; the final head untracks those redundant files without altering the reviewed source/evidence bytes, as disclosed in the package README. They remain historical objects and are not accepted source dependencies.
